_about: Golden calls: what each call must and must not trigger. tests/test_golden.py plays each 'script' as text partials (no GPU); `manage.py doctor --golden` streams each 'wav' through the real speech model and live path. Tool args listed under 'expect' must match exactly; 'times' is how often the tool must fire.
